title: RobustDebias: Debiasing Language Models using Distributionally Robust Optimization
benchmark_measurement: The benchmarks measured stereotypical associations and probability assignments related to religion. Specifically, they evaluated whether models were more likely to complete sentences with stereotypical religious terms or assign higher probabilities to sentences containing religious stereotypes compared to anti-stereotypes.
findings: The proposed method, RobustDebias, was found to be highly effective at mitigating religious bias across all tested models (BERT, RoBERTa, DistilBERT, ALBERT). It consistently achieved the best or second-best scores for the religion demographic on the SEAT and CrowS-Pairs benchmarks, outperforming traditional Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) and other Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) variants. This indicates that the method successfully reduces stereotypical associations related to religion during the model's fine-tuning process.
